Recommended Motion:
THAT
Report No. PDS-064-26 with respect to Application for Zoning By-law Amendment Z20-25 as requested by Doug. Tarry Limited for 83 Christie Drive and 2648 Harris Road
BE RECEIVED
for information.
AND THAT
Application for Zoning By-law Amendment Z20-25 requested by Doug. Tarry Limited to rezone portions of the subject property from the ‘Future Development (FD) Zone’ to two site-specific Residential Second Density with Holding Provision (R2-8-H, R2-9-H) Zones, a site-specific Residential Third Density with Holding Provision (R3-18-H) Zone, two site-specific Institutional (I-7, I-8) Zones, Open Space (OS) Zone, and Environmental Protection with Holding Provision (EP-H-6) Zone for lands legally described as Part of Lots 19 and 20, North Dorchester Concession B S.R.T.; and Part 1 of RP 33R19961, Municipality of Thames Centre be amended as recommended by staff and,
BE APPROVED
;
AND THAT
the implementing by-law be
CONSIDERED
, as included in the by-law portion of the agenda.
REASONS
•The application has regard for Section 2 of the Planning Act
•The application is consistent with the Provincial Planning Statement
•The application conforms to the County of Middlesex Official Plan
•The application conforms to the Municipality of Thames Centre Official Plan
